Bored of eating the same dinner every day? It's time to give your dinner menu a delicious upgrade! Discover 4 restaurant-style recipes you can make at home, from a flavourful mushroom starter and creamy soup to comforting pasta and an irresistible chocolate dessert.
Whether you're planning a special dinner with family or simply want to try something new, this menu has everything you need for a satisfying meal.
Butter Garlic Mushrooms – A delicious mix of shimeji, button and shiitake mushrooms tossed with butter, garlic, herbs and spices.
